"The qwzspace 0.6.3 http-sse-server + snapshot-manager pairing named by the render-migration ADR is not a strict superset of flickering-delve-service's and onestone-service's existing hand-rolled SSE transports for these two concrete, verbatim reasons (named SSE event routing; flat per-actor state vs entity-list projection). Both mismatches are real semantics the qwzspace transport as published cannot express without either modifying qwzspace itself or changing the two games' client JS, both out of the stated scope of this migration. Per instruction, the migration is stopped for BOTH services with no transport code touched; ADR's 'Realtime (QwzSpace) migration is a separate, later track' framing is correct to leave unresolved. This is a debt on qwzspace (or a future qwzspace minor) to add named-event / flat-frame support, not a defect in either game."
"Not reached — no code changed, nothing to deploy. Both services have no public DNS today per the task brief; deployment remains out of scope regardless."

"Swapping either service's transport onto qwzspace's http-sse-server as shipped would silently break both browser clients (their addEventListener(\"state\"/\"out\", ...) handlers would never fire, since EventSource delivers an unnamed data: frame as the default 'message' event) unless the client JS were also changed — which the task explicitly disallows ('their web clients must not need changes')."

"qwzspace 0.6.3 src/http-sse-server.mjs lines 39-65 (sseClient): send(obj) only ever does res.write(`data: ${JSON.stringify(obj)}\\n\\n`) — no event: field anywhere in the module, and createSseHandler({hub,queue,snapshot,tickNow,clientDir,eventsPath,actPath}) exposes no encode/event-name override."
"flickering-delve-service src/server.mts lines 73-75, 143-163: server emits `event: out` and `event: state` named SSE frames via its own sse(res,event,value) helper."
"flickering-delve-service src/client.mts lines 198-200: es.addEventListener(\"out\", ...) and es.addEventListener(\"state\", ...) — no onmessage fallback."
"onestone-service src/server.mts lines 174-176, 284: server emits `event: state` named SSE frames via its own sseWrite(res,event,value) helper."

"onestone-service src/client.mts lines 799-807: state.es.addEventListener(\"state\", ...), with an explicit in-code comment: 'server.mts emits frames as a named state SSE event ... not the default unnamed message event — listen on the actual event name it sends.'"

"qwzspace's http-sse-server (src/http-sse-server.mjs's sseClient()) writes every SSE frame as a bare `data: ...\\n\\n` line and never an `event: <name>` line. Both games' browser clients are hard-wired to EventSource.addEventListener() on NAMED events, not the default 'message' event."

"Adopting createSnapshotManager as shipped would require re-modeling each game's whole-state push as a one-entity-per-actor projection and unwrapping entities[0] client-side to recover today's flat shape — a client change, again disallowed by the task's constraint, and a real modeling contortion (subjectsOf/snapOf's per-entity dirty-tracking model does not fit 'push my whole state to me' semantics) rather than a like-for-like swap."
"qwzspace 0.6.3 src/snapshot-manager.mjs lines 8-13 (roomFrame): every frame is wrapped as {type, tick, entities, removed?, ack?}."
"flickering-delve-service src/server.mts line 115: broadcast(actor, \"state\", scene.stateFrame(actor)) — one flat object, no entity list."
"flickering-delve-service src/client.mts render(s) (post line 211): reads fields directly off s (s.essence, s.echoes, ...)."

"onestone-service src/server.mts lines 284-285: sseWrite(res,\"state\",deps.scene.frame(account)) then deps.scene.subscribe(account, frame => sseWrite(res,\"state\",frame)) — same flat-object model, driven by the scene's own change events, not a tick-numbered entity diff."

"qwzspace's snapshot-manager models state as an entity-list projection over subjectsOf(tick)/snapOf(id,tick), wire-shaped as {type,tick,entities,removed,ack} (src/snapshot-manager.mjs's roomFrame()). Both games instead push one flat per-actor scalar state object each tick/change (scene.stateFrame(actor) / deps.scene.frame(account) / deps.scene.subscribe(account, frame => ...)), consumed by the client as the frame itself (render(s) reads s.essence/s.echoes/... directly; onestone's handleFrame(JSON.parse(ev.data)) expects the ClientFrame shape directly), not as an entities[] envelope."
"STOPPED before any transport code was changed. Both services' src/server.mts are unmodified."
"flickering-delve-service and onestone-service realtime transport migration to @red-cup-engineering/qwzspace 0.6.3 is NOT a strict superset — migration stopped, no code changed"
